findings.title: Empty SQL result never returns NoData, always overwritten with TableData
findings.body: In pkg/expr/sql_command.go Execute() sets rsp.Values to mathexp.NoData when frame.Rows()==0 and then unconditionally overwrites rsp.Values with mathexp.TableData on the next lines. The NoData assignment is dead code and never observed by callers. Consequence: downstream no-data/alerting logic that distinguishes NoData from TableData will misclassify empty SQL results as data tables.

findings.title: tablesFromAST indexes ast[0] without empty check causing panic
findings.body: In pkg/expr/sql/parser.go tablesFromAST() does flatten.Flatten(ast[0], ...) without checking len(ast) > 0. If the unmarshalled JSON is an empty array, null, or otherwise yields zero elements, this panics with index out of range. Consequence: a crafted SQL expression that produces such JSON crashes the handler/goroutine, a denial-of-service robustness bug that should be a returned error instead.

findings.title: enableSqlExpressions has inverted check and always returns false via dead branches
findings.body: In pkg/expr/reader.go enableSqlExpressions() computes enabled as negation of FlagSqlExpressions then returns false in both the if branch and fallthrough. The flag check is dead code and the negation obscures intent. Consequence: the disable looks like a logic mistake, inviting a future cleanup to flip one return to true and silently re-enable the DuckDB RCE/LFI path fixed for CVE-2024-9264; it should be an unconditional false with an explicit security comment.

findings.title: Security disable of SQL expressions has no regression test
findings.body: This PR disables SQL expressions to fix critical RCE/LFI CVE-2024-9264 by gating pkg/expr/reader.go ReadQuery for QueryTypeSQL and stubbing pkg/expr/sql DB, but adds no test verifying that ReadQuery, NewSQLCommand/TablesList, and Execute reject SQL input even when FlagSqlExpressions is enabled. Consequence: a one-line future change to the stub or gate can silently reintroduce remote code execution/file access with no automated guard.
